meta.title: Reschedule an upcoming event: press Cancel
gaps: Directly assert that the event's persisted start time remains unchanged after pressing Cancel.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the event's persisted start time remains unchanged after pressing Cancel.

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ's summary as required for prepared-state cases.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where the Settings menu is available.
Open the stage Settings menu to access Reschedule Event.
Change the proposed live time but leave the Reschedule Event dialog open without confirming, so Cancel can be pressed.
Cancel the reschedule instead of submitting it.
Verify that pressing Cancel closes the reschedule dialog.
